nodes.label: Project operating contract for agents
nodes.rationale: Current directory, ownership, preservation and execution rules supersede former implementation plans. User instructions take precedence; selection, loading, construction, readiness and human approval remain separate.

nodes.label: Protected scientific inputs and authority
nodes.rationale: Administration preserves scientific inputs, researcher edits, missingness, source identity and diagnostic restrictions; it cannot repair diets, invent provenance or adopt scientific results.

nodes.label: Grouped regional ownership
nodes.rationale: Regions retain exact IDs and workbooks; papers own sources and distinct period/scenario models. JSON-only EcoBase candidates have an identical model layout, and discovery cannot invent citations, chronology or coverage.

nodes.label: Single canonical model.json
nodes.rationale: Each distinct model owns one supported Ecopath export plus adjacent notes covering identity, period/area, departures and evidence. Unknown departure provenance remains unknown; administrative fields remain outside scientific JSON.

nodes.label: Latest-only extraction policy
nodes.rationale: Lineage depends on identity, period, area, scenario and recorded corrections rather than modification time. Keep the latest extraction; remove superseded packages without merging unique old evidence, recording losses and affected results.

nodes.label: Overview selection authority
nodes.rationale: Regional Overview choice and rationale are editable selection authority. Paths, Project selected flags, HTML and shortcuts are derived; map defaults do not prevent review or switching of exact candidates.

nodes.label: One-command regional refresh
nodes.rationale: Choosing an existing registered candidate needs Overview choice/rationale plus region refresh. Canonical discovery ignores work copies, snapshots and shortcuts and rejects duplicate identities.

nodes.label: Full regional workbook snapshot
nodes.rationale: Save atomic byte-for-byte copies under actual results_model_id, preserving sheets, manual content, formatting and links. Incoming selection and outgoing result identities may differ; an empty pending workbook cannot replace a useful snapshot.

nodes.label: Selective compatible restoration
nodes.rationale: Restore only allowlisted compatible model-dependent groups, coefficients, matching and diagnostics, retaining current independent inputs and human entries. Unknown/incompatible model, code or flags prohibit numerical reuse; ready arithmetic retains FAIL, NOT_RUN, provisional and missing states.

nodes.label: Portable source disposition ledger
nodes.rationale: Every relocation/removal records reason and portable path/hash evidence; path-only link changes do not renew approval. Preserve external URLs/Word anchors and full source bytes under Git LFS policy.

nodes.label: Model-local output ownership
nodes.rationale: Each exact model owns coefficient source, native inputs/provenance, latest extracted tables, regional snapshot, manifest, diagnostics and validation evidence/work. Multiple regional applications retain their own results.

nodes.label: Shared implementation homes
nodes.rationale: Commands, project-core responsibilities, scientific engines/helpers and focused checks each have their documented homes; two active project skills and one bounded canonical graph provide current navigation.

nodes.label: Temporary work and promotion
nodes.rationale: Named regional preparation or model-validation run folders contain inputs/outputs/code/qa. Promote necessary current evidence and remove redundant temporary outputs; work must not become an extraction archive.

nodes.label: Result manifest identity
nodes.rationale: Manifests distinguish actual model/result identity, snapshot selection, flags/code identity, artifact hashes and separate dependency hashes. Unknown historical flags/code stay unknown, and manifests confer no approval.

nodes.label: Serialized publication and rollback
nodes.rationale: Serialize Project.xlsx writes; technical failures roll back coherently while missing scientific prerequisites preserve requested selection with an exact pending reason.

nodes.label: One shared mapping decision stage
nodes.rationale: Resolve taxon-to-group mapping once using combined pipeline/validation requirements and hand off keyed group/weight/confidence/evidence decisions. Full validation covers all catch taxa including zero rows and separates membership/allocation confidence.

nodes.label: Researcher Word preservation and parser compatibility
nodes.rationale: Preserve researcher text, manual appendix cells, deletions, signatures, breaks and links; render every edited page. Parser-label edits require before/after summaries and unexpected identity/date/section/reference changes block adoption.

nodes.label: Coherent content-checked read sessions
nodes.rationale: Saved-table inspection establishes only its narrow scope. Recheck consumed bytes before publication; a read session observing input change cannot publish mixed versions.

nodes.label: Verified graph source freshness
nodes.rationale: The single canonical graph and its scope index stated evidence; unchanged eligible sources can be reused but changed/relocated concepts need current verification. Graphs, partial QA and historical execution cannot grant scientific approval.

nodes.label: Extracted model values versus the calculation model
nodes.rationale: Canonical extracted values may already incorporate accepted transformations. Input hash, selection, executed code and settings identify a result; ephemeral loading changes the representation further.

nodes.label: Extracted model values versus calculation model
nodes.rationale: Extracted source values, accepted canonical variant and runtime state are distinct. A variant owns one canonical JSON and notes; compare source and runtime evidence before scientific interpretation.

nodes.label: Forward model-loading sequence
nodes.rationale: The explicit sequence is selected input, parsed groups/flows, deterministic completion, optional LIM, runtime vectors and SPPR; source and resulting runtime state both need inspection.

nodes.label: Exporter versus bare-constructor defaults
nodes.rationale: Exporter enables underdetermined LIM, normalization and leaves missing living BA for solving; bare construction differs. zero_catch and GS defaults are assumptions, candidate-specific recorded settings govern use, and equal optimization weights do not make guesses observations.

nodes.label: Runtime diet normalization and BA closure
nodes.rationale: When requested, every nonzero diet row including imported food is rescaled even within tolerance. Eligible originally consistent living groups receive a negative predation-delta BA offset; other groups retain BA with reasons. Input JSON/ModelData remain unchanged, and closure is not observed BA.

nodes.label: Deterministic runtime completion
nodes.rationale: Parsing derives production/consumption/mortality, and calculator defaults/fills flows then solves one-missing-term balances and recomputes rates. Biomass=1 is a placeholder and does not reconstruct missing production/consumption; defaults are not source observations.

nodes.label: net_migration sign convention
nodes.rationale: Parsed migration is emigration minus immigration. Runtime subtracts detritus import to represent an external inflow, with absent migration/import defaulting to zero.

nodes.label: Detritus fate finalization
nodes.rationale: Synthetic diet_import and missing-diet zeros precede routing. DET×DET is forced to identity and Import row to zero; absent living routes default only for one pool, absent multi-pool routes reject, and partial remainder is export. Detritus flows/accumulation are recomputed.

nodes.label: Per-group Linear Inverse Model completion
nodes.rationale: LIM optimizes missing flows per group while holding known flows, diets and predation fixed. Post-LIM predation/detritus refresh can reveal residuals; this is not coupled web reconstruction. Failure leaves unsolved cells missing, and later zero/one runtime fallbacks need review.

nodes.label: Separate balanced_model copy
nodes.rationale: Construction creates a separate balanced copy absorbing residuals into growth/net migration while preserving production. Exporter returns the original completed calculator; SPPR uses it unless explicitly substituted. Algebraic balance is not scientific approval.

nodes.label: Loaded-diet trophic levels
nodes.rationale: Real-group TL begins missing and is calculated from the loaded diet via (I−DC)⁻¹·1 without initialization cycle removal; it may differ from published TL.

nodes.label: LIM tiny-EE precision correction
nodes.rationale: Finalization sets abs(EE)<1e-10 exactly to zero via runtime M0=P before detritus refresh. Missing/outside-cutoff EE and input JSON remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Name-based small-zooplankton GS default
nodes.rationale: A hard-coded multilingual name whitelist after removing spaces, underscores and hyphens gives missing consumer GS=0.4; other consumers receive 0.2. This is name matching and existing GS is retained.

nodes.label: Where to find things
nodes.rationale: Project.xlsx supplies central metadata/reviews, regional workbooks supply local inputs/results and interactive_map supplies generated views. The example LME_028 is Guinea Current.

nodes.label: Regional paper and candidate layout
nodes.rationale: LME/EEZ/HS regions keep workbook/raw/papers/ecobase/work. Paper sources/manifests own distinct models; JSON-only EcoBase candidates use the same model layout without invented publication provenance.

nodes.label: Model folder layout
nodes.rationale: One canonical JSON and notes, exact coefficient source, native inputs, latest extracted tables, saved results/manifest/diagnostics and validation report/mapping/evidence belong to a distinct model.

nodes.label: Saved snapshot navigation
nodes.rationale: Complete saved workbook may show incoming Overview selection while calculations belong to outgoing model; adjacent manifest retains both and restoration follows model-selection compatibility.

nodes.label: Saved map and shortcut navigation
nodes.rationale: Map/shortcut reflect saved state and do not select/approve models. Local shortcuts may need regeneration after clone/move; map launcher serves the saved views.

nodes.label: Research ownership and historical evidence
nodes.rationale: Research placement follows purpose/ownership, not who typed files. Agent assistance does not confer approval; move complete study packages retaining historical execution records.

nodes.label: Extraction table recovery implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Proposed on 8 October 2026 and not executed. Restore exact article/native values plus explicit authorized changes before runtime transforms; this plan authorizes no parameter repair, selection, calculation or signoff.

nodes.label: Verified extraction package starting inventory
nodes.rationale: 61 canonical regional directories: 32 paper models have root standard tables, 3 have nested tables, 23 have none, and 3 are JSON-only candidates with separate source roles. Three root-table packages have taxonomy-only gaps. Counts describe availability, not fidelity or approval.

nodes.label: Recovery route selection
nodes.rationale: Prefer verified byte-preserving relocation, then verified embedded snapshots or ledger-gated JSON translation. Recover missing literals/masks/units/identity from primary sources; schema success/runtime success cannot prove fidelity.

nodes.label: Accepted pre-runtime cell ledger
nodes.rationale: Each adopted source-stated/estimated/authorized/unknown cell records source and accepted literal, masks, units, spatial basis, locators/hashes, JSON pointer and authorization. Missing authorization blocks discrepancies; runtime logs are not researcher decisions.

nodes.label: Exact source decimal and missing-mask fidelity
nodes.rationale: CSV literal text and masks must match exactly; XLSX numeric values and source-compatible display precision are separately verified. Zero, blank, sentinel, estimate, accepted correction and derived summary remain distinct.

nodes.label: Verified nested-package relocation
nodes.rationale: Verify exact model/version and source ledger before staging intact tables. Check hashes, group order and companions; move only matching tables, preserve manual edits and resolve conflicting destinations without silent overwrite.

nodes.label: Offline ledger-gated table exporter
nodes.rationale: Proposed recover_tables.py reads immutable JSON plus verified ledger, uses decimal literals and maintained writer/source_fidelity, rejects missing authority/identity/conflicts/unit conversion and never invokes runtime loader. Writer-schema JSON is temporary and cannot replace canonical export.

nodes.label: Primary-source recovery blockers
nodes.rationale: Unrepresented fields require actual article/native evidence. Unread source cannot be called unreported; missing fleet partitions, source TL, metadata, units and source precision are explicit unresolved gaps rather than guesses.

nodes.label: Source taxonomy and published companions
nodes.rationale: Recover taxonomy only within stage authorization, preserving seq/group_name/taxon_descr and unknown membership; preserve stanza, migration, fleet, constraint and role evidence in purpose-specific companions rather than claimed import tables.

nodes.label: Protected-file and cell-fidelity promotion gate
nodes.rationale: Reopen outputs against source ledger/masks, separately check numeric tolerances/display precision, investigate non-unit sums without normalization and round-trip only work copies. Recheck JSON/sources/workbooks/results/signed reports/notebooks hashes; unexpected protected changes stop promotion.

nodes.label: Model-local recovery receipt and gap dispositions
nodes.rationale: Promote only verified latest tables/applicable taxonomy/companions/evidence to exact model. Receipts record hashes, tool/routes/authority and remaining gaps; every original gap is relocation/reconstruction/blocker/inapplicable, not completion by filename.

nodes.label: HS_077 ETP7 Eastern tropical Pacific 1993-1997 model
nodes.rationale: ETP-2003__HS_077; period 1993–1997. Corrected canonical SHA256 86cd1a54316e1cdd401e49355a2a75f65f462e15d21c287b55f9894ec54c6e84; explicit researcher-preserved original_model.json is the former working representation, not a pristine publication extraction.

nodes.label: ETP7 provisional numerical display
nodes.rationale: Corrected GE/TE/With Egestion run yields WARN health grades; GE/With Egestion pass strict SPPR balance, TE fails strict balance. Production eligibility stays false and provisional numbers stay restricted despite signed validation; historical sensitivity bounds were invalidated.

nodes.label: ETP7 researcher-adopted diet placement corrections
nodes.rationale: Researcher adopted five exact-value predator-column relocations on 2026-10-08, preserving identity/non-diet/import/unknown/unrelated values. Nine material totals now 1.000, Albacore stays 1.001 without rounding; author intent remains unconfirmed.

nodes.label: ETP7 graded health and strict SPPR diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Fresh reviewed notebook/default GE, TE and With Egestion have WARN diagnostic grades. Strict SPPR balance passes GE/With Egestion but fails TE; these are distinct from researcher acceptance and production eligibility.

nodes.label: ETP7 signed researcher validation and display exclusions
nodes.rationale: Ido Carmel signed MODEL VALIDATED on 08/10/2026; seven named exclusions apply only to displayed PPR and are registered centrally/on map. Signed historical descriptions remain, with current scientific discrepancies recorded in model notes.

nodes.label: ETP7 reconstructed geographic fit
nodes.rationale: Published p137/PDF7 describes 20N–20S from 150W to approximate American shelf break, 32.8 million km². No original study map found; labelled reconstruction yields A≈47%, B≈46–48% with low geographic confidence from shelf/coast/target uncertainty.

nodes.label: ETP7 historical pre-correction signed-source description
nodes.rationale: The quoted signed paragraph retaining nine material diet-sum errors is explicitly historical and superseded for current placements. Missing publication cells/decision provenance stay unknown; loadability or automatic fidelity checks do not establish fidelity/approval.

nodes.label: LME_013 Chiaverano detailed Humboldt computational model
nodes.rationale: HUM-2018__LME_013; period 1995–1998. Current corrected canonical SHA256 11cbf610b7d2514085bd0d079b385cf9419e15308493b3a35183673553c5adb7. Historical c9ddb57... byte preservation concerns relocation only; source-backed corrections are current departures.

nodes.label: HUM-2018 Northern Humboldt source identity
nodes.rationale: Native supplement has 41 nodes, 39 stocks/pools and two fleets. Researcher adopted source-backed diet/catch corrections on 8 October 2026; article Table1/ScenarioIII still support older high catch, leaving author intention inconsistent.

nodes.label: Humboldt native stock and fleet representation
nodes.rationale: Computational representation keeps 39 stocks with corrections and execution conventions habitat=1, BA/migration/external import=0 for unreported values. Fleet ancestry/landings/discards/export fates remain companions because stock JSON cannot fully encode them.

nodes.label: Humboldt Eggs 36 nonfeeding-pool convention
nodes.rationale: Eggs36 is operational pp=2/nonfeeding because source rates are blank; prose 25% egg production is not annual P/B. Unknown sentinel −9999 and baseline convention differences remain distinct from current scientific corrections.

nodes.label: Humboldt Sardine supplement and article catch conflict
nodes.rationale: On 8 October researcher adopted article landings=1.4 replacing supplement=5.6513425; discards=0.17462648325 stay, export=1.57462648325. EE derived from normalized predation/catch/production becomes 0.6872065402096068 instead of model-estimated 0.9700034856796265. Older high-catch article evidence remains inconsistent; adopted values are reconstruction/derived correction, not newly printed data.

nodes.label: Humboldt large-jellyfish native diet excess
nodes.rationale: Historical contradictory TableB Chrysaora row total1.045 is replaced by researcher-adopted diet [Diatoms0,Meso0.68,Macro0.17,Gelatinous0,Eggs0.15]. 68/17 reconstruct supplement H I14/J14 and E singleton identities, zero links F14/K14, eggs B H39; original source cells remain evidence.

nodes.label: Humboldt diagnostic diet normalization and identity routing
nodes.rationale: Runtime diet normalization stays separate from canonical corrections; native pool-fate identity replacement remains an unsupported translation restriction. Current evidence does not restate old counts of changed cells.

nodes.label: Humboldt traced source geography and fixed-period extrapolation
nodes.rationale: Reviewed Figure1 trace gives approximate A6–8%,B90–100% with reported-area discrepancy. Fixed model and allocations over 1950–2019 are extrapolations.

nodes.label: Humboldt corrected-model diagnostics and pooled budgets
nodes.rationale: Fresh GE/TE/With Egestion overall grades stay FAIL. Pooled GE/With Egestion eliminate negative coefficients and pass SPPR budgets without removing unpooled convergence failure; TE unchanged by pooling fails primary-production budget. Living mass balance passes notebook and zero-BA-preserving validation constructors; no current MC bounds claimed.

nodes.label: Humboldt conditional researcher approval with auto detritus
nodes.rationale: Ido Carmel signed MODEL VALIDATED on 8 October 2026 conditional on every SPPR_new-related calculation using det_collapse_mode=auto (user called collapse_det_mode). Fresh auto evidence exactly reproduces prior pooled matrices/adopted coefficients; approval does not change any overall FAIL grade.

nodes.label: Humboldt signed display-only exclusions and original allocations
nodes.rationale: Signed review excludes Cetaceans,Fishery offal,Pinnipeds,Seabirds,Chrysaora from webpage PPR only. Scientific groups/diets/catch/coefficients/allocation weights remain; allocation proxies retain native source landings despite corrected sardine export.

nodes.label: Researcher-signed review registration and bounded map refresh
nodes.rationale: Authorized latest actual signed Word review supplies real signer/date/exact model and validated or disqualified verdict. Draft/healthy diagnostics/template approval cannot authorize adoption; bounded registration changes review metadata/display policy only.

nodes.label: read_report and register_review signed-source APIs
nodes.rationale: read_report validates actual signer/date/verdict/model and exact rejection reason; register_review updates one Models row with report/hash/model/input identity and summary, preserving science/selection. Unselected source-only disqualification binds model/report hashes without borrowing default inputs; validated sections need reviewed calculation inputs.

nodes.label: refresh_reviews replay fingerprint gate
nodes.rationale: refresh_reviews accepts explicit model_ids, serializes publication and compares pre-registration snapshot replay/all decompressed parts, allowing targeted review/exclusions/new fingerprint only. Stale fingerprint/unrelated changes block bounded handoff; full build/run cannot bypass it.

nodes.label: Approved display-only group exclusions
nodes.rationale: Validated exclusions resolve actual results_model_id before selection fallback and exact Groups.seq/names. No removals means []; absent labels require authorized honest applicability handling. Disqualification excluded_seq=[] transfers no removals; webpage PPR only changes with original shares, science/denominators/NPP retained and controls disabled.

nodes.label: Validated disqualified and unreviewed map states
nodes.rationale: Positive status displays green six flat sections; disqualification red exact verdict/reason/signer/date/link and stays selectable but excluded from positive filter. Unreviewed has only red pending line. Confidence remains at signed year/basis/simple-chain universe independent of live UI.

nodes.label: Exact reviewed-workbook applicability and pending review
nodes.rationale: Positive numerical adoption requires workbook_sha256 equal to exact reviewed current result workbook/snapshot. Mismatch retains signed/selectable model as recorded_review_pending with no active approval/exclusions; review-only verified decisions may display without copying default calculations.

nodes.label: Signed confidence table verbatim transfer
nodes.rationale: Validated confidence transfer is only introductory text before actual Overall confidence table plus table. Verify every final Word percentage is two significant digits with explicit %, then map/trends exactly match Word; rejection-only transfer does not require tables or authorize Word edits.

nodes.label: Source-to-map review equality acceptance
nodes.rationale: Fresh read_report must match central row/map/trends verdict/reason/signer/date/hash/path and validated section segments/links/breaks/confidence/reference/exclusions/note. Later Word edits require registration/hash refresh; changed identities require scoped review.

Diagnostic grades strict checks and researcher acceptance remain distinct
